subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester
Ich streite mich mit meiner Schwester
Ich ärgere mich über meine Schwester
questions.explain: 'Sich gut verstehen mit' means 'to get on well with', so this is 'I get on well with my sister'.

questions.q: What does 'mein älterer Bruder' mean?
questions.explain: 'Älter' means 'older', so 'mein älterer Bruder' = 'my older brother'. 'Jünger' would be younger.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'My parents are divorced'?
questions.explain: 'Geschieden' = 'divorced'; 'verheiratet' (married) and 'verlobt' (engaged) are near-miss distractors.

questions.q: What does 'Ich kann mich auf ihn verlassen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich verlassen auf' means 'to rely on'. (Watch out: 'verlassen' on its own means 'to leave'.)

questions.q: How do you say 'I have brown hair and blue eyes'?
options: Ich habe braune Haare und blaue Augen
Ich bin braune Haare und blaue Augen
Ich habe blaue Haare und braune Augen
Ich habe braun Haare und blau Augen
questions.explain: Use 'haben' for features and add the plural adjective ending -e: 'braune Haare', 'blaue Augen'.

questions.q: What does 'Wir streiten uns manchmal' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich streiten' means 'to argue', so 'Wir streiten uns manchmal' = 'We argue sometimes'.

questions.q: What does 'gesund leben' mean?
questions.explain: 'Gesund' means 'healthy', so 'gesund leben' = 'to live healthily'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid fatty food'?
questions.explain: 'Man muss' = 'one must' and 'vermeiden' = 'to avoid', so this means 'You must avoid fatty food'.

questions.q: What does 'das Rauchen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do sport to keep fit'?
options: Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um dick zu werden
Ich treibe Sport, weil ich fit bin
Er treibt Sport, um fit zu bleiben
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport' and 'um... fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to keep fit'; 'ich treibe' is the correct form.

questions.q: What does 'das Wohlbefinden' mean?
questions.explain: 'Das Wohlbefinden' means 'wellbeing'. ('Die Wohnung' = flat — a near-miss distractor.)

questions.q: What does 'eine Prüfung bestehen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Bestehen' means 'to pass', so 'eine Prüfung bestehen' = 'to pass an exam'. To fail is 'durchfallen'.

questions.q: What does 'die Note' mean (at school)?
questions.explain: False friend: 'die Note' is a school 'grade/mark' (e.g. 'eine gute Note'), not an English 'note'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have to revise for my exams'?
options: Ich muss für meine Prüfungen lernen
Ich habe Lust auf meine Prüfungen
questions.explain: 'Lernen' here means 'to study/revise' and 'müssen' = 'to have to', so this means 'I have to revise for my exams'.

questions.q: What does 'das Fach' mean (at school)?
questions.explain: 'Das Fach' means 'a (school) subject', e.g. 'mein Lieblingsfach' = 'my favourite subject'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to become a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Ich möchte... werden' = 'I would like to become' and 'Krankenpfleger' = 'nurse'; 'krank' (ill) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: What does 'die Arbeitslosigkeit' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Arbeitslosigkeit' means 'unemployment'; 'arbeitslos' = 'unemployed'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Yesterday I worked a lot' (past)?
questions.explain: 'Habe... gearbeitet' is the perfect tense 'worked'; with 'gestern' (yesterday) the perfect is correct, and the past participle goes to the end.

questions.q: What does 'Ich bekomme ein Geschenk' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'bekommen' means 'to get/receive', not 'to become'. 'To become' is 'werden'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich bin sensibel' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'sensibel' means 'sensitive'. 'Sensible' (English) would be 'vernünftig'.
